mechanism: Cimetidine inhibits CYP1A2 and CYP3A4, reducing phenelzine metabolism and increasing its concentration; combined CNS effects and potential for hypertensive crisis with tyramine-containing foods.
action: Avoid concurrent use or select alternative H2-blocker (famotidine); if unavoidable, use lowest phenelzine dose with close monitoring for serotonergic toxicity and hypertensive episodes.
